name: Amg8833 Hotspot Presence Alarm
description: Scan the AMG8833's 64-pixel grid and print to the serial console once per second. Find the pixel with the highest temperature; use zero-based row-major coordinates, row = pixel index / 8 and column = pixel index % 8 (integer division, indices 0-63). If its temperature is strictly greater than 30 degrees Celsius, light the LED and print that presence is detected, with that pixel's row and column (0-7) and its temperature in degrees Celsius. Otherwise, turn off the LED and print that there is no presence. The AMG8833 is at I2C address 0x69.

tests.parse: Hotspot Row: {row:d} Col: {col:d} Temp: {temp:f.1} C, Presence: detected
Presence: none
Hotspot Row: {d} Col: {d} Temp: {f.1} C, Presence: detected
Presence: none

tests.expect: len(@hot0) + len(@quiet0) >= 1 && len(@row) == len(@col) && len(@col) == len(@temp)

tests.parse: Hotspot Row: {row:d} Col: {col:d} Temp: {temp:f.1} C, Presence: detected
Presence: none
Hotspot Row: {d} Col: {d} Temp: {f.1} C, Presence: detected
Presence: none

tests.expect: len(@hot1) + len(@quiet1) - len(@hot0) - len(@quiet0) >= 4 && len(@hot1) + len(@quiet1) - len(@hot0) - len(@quiet0) <= 6 && len(@row) == len(@col) && len(@col) == len(@temp)
